Talent0_2Ability.name: Poised Starburst
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf> after combat, stacking up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. After actively attacking, if possessing <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>, immediately removes <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>, gains <color=#F74848>3</color> AP and the corresponding <buf ID=900138>[Temporary AP Cap]</buf>, and triggers <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Poised Starburst
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf> after combat, stacking up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. After actively attacking, if possessing <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>, immediately removes <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>, gains <color=#F74848>3</color> AP and the corresponding <buf ID=900138>[Temporary AP Cap]</buf>, and triggers <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
Upon deployment, gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>. At start of action, if the last action triggered the <buf ID=900133>[Poised]</buf> AP regen effect, additionally regens <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101702.name: Shatter Defense
101702.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> to parts with HP above or equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

101703.name: Serene Core
101703.SpecificEffects: When attacked by Melee or Ranged Weapons, if equipped with two Alter-Blades and both Arms are undestroyed, triggers <buf ID=900136>[Critical Sense]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101704.name: Starfall Flash
101704.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> target within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles (including flying targets) and strikes using Alter-Blades to deal <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Can enter <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking, then remains on a random empty tile within <color=#F74848>1</color> ring around the target after hitting.

101705.name: Nano Reassembly
101705.SpecificEffects: When any Arm is destroyed, restores <color=#F74848>50%</color> HP to <color=#F74848>1</color> Arm after combat. This effect can trigger again after an interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

101706.name: Skybreaker Slash
101706.describe: Uses two Alter-Blades to attack all targets within an <range type=2>I-shaped (3x1-tile)</range> area or <range type=2>L-shaped (3x1-tile)</range> area ahead. Before attacking, can Aim at all targets separately, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> AoE DMG.

101707.name: Focus Breaker
101707.SpecificEffects: At start of action, if there are <color=#F74848>3</color> or more enemies within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles, gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>.

101708.name: Radiant End
101708.describe: Uses two Alter-Blades to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2.4x</color> DMG. This attack prioritizes the Body, and grants <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Poised]</buf>.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101531.name: Terminator 1
101531.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking with an Alter-Blade, if the part hit is below <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP, triggers the <buf ID=900109>[Execution]</buf> effect, directly destroying that part after combat.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101534.name: Terminator 2
101534.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1015311>[Terminator 1]</buf> part destruction effect threshold increased to <color=#F74848>25%</color> HP.

101535.name: Terminator 3
101535.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=900101>[Terminator]</buf> to destroy a part, negates the deduction of <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> count and additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101536.name: Terminator 4
101536.SpecificEffects: When using an Alter-Blade to destroy parts other than the Body, inflicts <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> on the Body equal to <color=#F74848>25%</color> of the destroyed part's Max HP.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101744.name: Binary Starflare 2
101744.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900133>[Poised]</buf> can stack up to <color=#F74848>7</color> times.

101745.name: Binary Starflare 3
101745.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900133>[Poised]</buf> additionally increases Crit Rate by <color=#F74848>3%</color>.

101746.name: Binary Starflare 4
101746.SpecificEffects: Talent effect is enhanced to restore <color=#F74848>5</color> AP, and additionally grants <buf ID=1017466>[Stellar Burst]</buf> for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

hiddenSkills.name: Blitz Strike
hiddenSkills.describe: Attacks a target with two Alter-Blades, dealing <color=#F74848>0.85x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.
